name: PauseAllWait
shortDescription: Automatically freezes all asynchronous Wait actions when the game is paused.
description: A powerful and lightweight extension that fixes a well-known issue in GDevelop: asynchronous "Wait" actions do not natively respect custom pause variables, keeping running in the background.

This extension injects a global patch into the engine's AsyncTasksManager. It adds a single action you can run "At the beginning of the scene" to automatically freeze all active Waits when your chosen Global Variable is set to 1, and resumes them perfectly when it goes back to 0.
This extension is specifically designed for developers who handle their pause system WITHIN THE SAME SCENE (using a variable like PauseGame and setting the timescale to 0).
1. Put the action "Activate the fix to pause all Waits" under the "At the beginning of the scene" condition.
2. In the action parameter, type the exact name of your global pause variable enclosed in double quotes (e.g., "PauseGame").
3. That's it! All your Waits across the scene will now obey your pause system automatically.
